fusions.name: Venom Set Alight
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. You spit venom through flame across the 3 tiles ahead of you: it deals 9 fire damage to everything in the cone and sets each target [Burning] for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Fever Breaks
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. The bite deals 20 fire damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage, and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking by the Coals
fusions.desc: You regain 8 health at once, and your attack speed rises by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Heat Signature
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
